answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in vertex, expire in voyage, and karst lists each expiry. Anyone running 17 aliases therefore needs 147 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2232 identities would post 1239 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
